sections.heading: Section 1: Arc Length of a Plane Curve

questions.q: State the formula for the arc length $L$ of $y = f(x)$ from $x = a$ to $x = b$.
Find the arc length of $y = \frac{2}{3}x^{3/2}$ from $x = 0$ to $x = 3$.
Find the arc length of the line segment $y = \frac{4}{3}x + 2$ from $x = 0$ to $x = 3$.

sections.heading: Section 2: Improper Integrals of Type I (Infinite Bounds)

questions.q: For what values of $p$ does the improper integral $\int_1^\infty \frac{1}{x^p}\,dx$ converge?
questions.answer: By the $p$-integral test on $[1, \infty)$, $\int_1^\infty x^{-p}\,dx$ converges if and only if $p > 1$. For $p \leq 1$, it diverges.

sections.heading: Section 3: Improper Integrals of Type II (Discontinuous Integrands)

questions.answer: Infinite discontinuity at $x = 1$. Split: $\int_0^1 + \int_1^2$. $\int_0^1 \frac{dx}{x-1} = \lim_{b \to 1^-} [\ln|x-1|]_0^b = \lim_{b \to 1^-} \ln|b-1| - 0 = -\infty$. Since one part diverges, the integral diverges.

questions.q: For what values of $p$ does $\int_0^1 \frac{1}{x^p}\,dx$ converge?
questions.answer: Near 0, $\int_0^1 x^{-p}\,dx = [\frac{x^{1-p}}{1-p}]_0^1$. This converges if and only if the exponent $1 - p > 0 \Rightarrow p < 1$.

sections.heading: Section 4: Comparison Test for Improper Integrals

questions.answer: Since $0 \leq \frac{\sin^2(x)}{x^2} \leq \frac{1}{x^2}$ and $\int_1^\infty \frac{1}{x^2}\,dx$ converges, by the Direct Comparison Test the integral converges.
For large $x$, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^3 + 1}} \approx \frac{1}{x^{3/2}}$. By the Limit Comparison Test with $p = 3/2 > 1$, the integral converges.
